title: Butterscotch Budino
description: This butterscotch budino is rich and luxurious, just as the Italian custard pudding should be! Use Chef John's salted caramel sauce for an extra-decadent treat.

steps.text: Combine brown sugar, salt, and water in a deep, heavy-bottomed saucepan and place over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil; cook until caramel is very dark, and bubbles appear, 7 to 10 minutes. Immediately turn off the heat.
Carefully whisk in 2 tablespoons butter; pour in heavy cream and continue to stir. Be careful, as mixture may boil up in the pan. Stir over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves. Whisk in milk.

Whisk whole egg, egg yolks, and 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon cornstarch together in a mixing bowl. Slowly whisk in 1 cup of hot cream mixture to temper egg mixture. Whisk egg mixture into the saucepan and increase heat to medium-high. Bring to a simmer, and cook, whisking, until mixture thickens, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and pour into a fine-mesh strainer set over a bowl to remove any lumps. Whisk in rum.
Pour into serving glasses. Let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes, before wrapping in plastic wrap and refrigerating until thoroughly chilled, 3 to 4 hours.

video.description: A rich and satisfying Italian dessert can be yours with this delicious recipe. In this video, Chef John makes butterscotch budino, also known as Italian custard pudding. With a combination of ingredients such as brown sugar, heavy cream, and rum, see as Chef John whips together a sweet pudding that he describes as “smooth and luxurious”. To see the step-by-step process of the butterscotch budino, watch the video.
